text_block_list.text:
The day of the Yushun Himba (Oaks), the 
second leg of the Triple Tiara, had 
finally arrived.

Going through her usual relaxation 
routine, Air Messiah had finished all her 
preparations, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
――Now then. Let us begin our meeting 
regarding final adjustments for the Yushun 
Himba (Japanese Oaks).
choice_data_list: I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.text:
"...Come to think of it. Even during this 
meeting, Air Messiah had a tense 
expression on her face. What's more—"

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Tokyo Racecourse is defined by its long 
final straight. The contest in the final 
spurt... in other words, a battle of 
late-stage bursts will be crucial.

The razor-sharp finishing kick inherited 
from her mother was undoubtedly one of Air 
Messiah's greatest weapons. She agreed 
with that much, however...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: —...However.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of late-race bursts... that's 
also the main weapon of Cesario, who will 
likely be the biggest rival in this Yushun 
Himba (Japanese Oaks), isn't it?

Of course, there is no way I could deny 
it. I even checked the data from recent 
mock races, but...

Cesario's final 3 furlongs... Her time for 
the last 600 meters was the fastest among 
all runners in almost every single race.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Rhein Kraft-san's growth has far surpassed 
our wildest imaginations.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"In that case, perhaps Cesario is as 
well... That is how we should view it."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
After all, she too is an exceptional— 
monstrous existence.

I update Cesario's entry in "Rival Data 
Analysis_42." Calculating projections 
based on mock race times and other 
metrics—

With that established, I compare it with 
'Skill Chart Analysis_51', which details 
Air Messiah's abilities. Heading toward 
the Oaks, what must we polish...?
choice_data_list:
That said... stamina might still be the 
main issue.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ! ...Is that so?

I nod and present various data. Cesario's 
late burst is certainly formidable, but... 
being overly cautious of that alone 
wouldn't be wise.

First and foremost, the Oaks is 800m 
longer than the Oka Sho. In short, it 
demands an exceptionally tough physique.
choice_data_list: So, aiming to strengthen that aspect—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...No, um—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Um... Won't you reconsider it just a 
little?

...If it exceeded expectations, make 
corrections. Even so, analyze and think 
based on the data, and take it step by 
step toward the goal.

That was their way of doing things. And it 
was none other than she herself who showed 
that this was what truly mattered.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. Please give me... just a little 
more time to think it over, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Against someone like Cesario... Is it 
really okay not to focus on strengthening 
her late burst?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Please.

In truth, it didn't lead to a conclusion 
like hastily changing the training 
regimen.

Air Messiah also made a calm judgment 
based on analysis in the end. ...However,

"Even so, looking at her expression 
today... it makes me wonder if we really 
came to the right conclusion back then."

Careful not to let her notice, I firmly 
pinch my own thigh behind my back... 
hoping the pain will furrow my brow and 
give me at least a somewhat commanding 
expression.
And then, she raised her voice clearly.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ! ...Trainer.
choice_data_list:
Let's believe in everything we've built 
up!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. I'm sorry. That wasn't 
like me.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"In the end, we didn't change our routine. 
Steadily, surely, we just kept doing what 
we needed to do, as always."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"That is strength. So I make use of it. 
...That's all there was to it."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. ...I shall be on my 
way.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(...Yes. I have to believe. In my 
strength. In our strength.)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: That is the only thing I have left...!
